runtime_notes: Item tags are live resolved runtime membership; minecraft_tags_direct is intentionally empty because runtime tag APIs do not expose direct provenance.
Recipe outputs use Recipe#getResultItem, so multi-output custom recipes may need a later extractor pass.
Creative tabs are rebuilt from live runtime tab contents when the loader exposes them; search/inventory/hotbar/op tabs are omitted.
Model and loot-table fields are intentionally empty in runtime export v1.
